purpose: Quantify whether native multiplicity, recoverable multiscale velocity dispersion, and oriented local observation patches add target-predictive information beyond the scalar V14 backbone before freezing a new learned conditional residual model.

measurements: multi-galaxy cell fraction among occupied cells
fraction of selected galaxies lying in multi-galaxy cells
native_multiplicity_audit.intrinsic_within_cell_sig_v_recoverabili: not recoverable from the frozen two-channel HDF5 because only count and cell mean velocity were retained
native_multiplicity_audit.materiality_threshold: at least 0.10 of selected galaxies lie in native cells with count>=2 in any development domain

recoverable_context.block_backbone_mean_std: mean and standard deviation of V14 corrected backbone plus predicted residual DC
recoverable_context.local_patch: periodic 3x3x3 coarse-grid neighborhood mean and standard deviation of log1p block count, block mean velocity, and block backbone mean
recoverable_context.radius: distance of coarse-cell centre from the observer divided by the 10 Mpc/h cube half-width
recoverable_context.target: nonoverlapping block mean of physical y residual truth minus V14 backbone

fixed_linear_controls.fit: one source-balanced float64 ridge normal equation over all three train domains
fixed_linear_controls.feature_standardization: equal-source train-only mean and standard deviation

train_row_selection.factor_4: one of eight parity sublattices per cube, offsets ((i),(i//2),(i//4)) mod 2, yielding 8^3 rows per cube

fixed_linear_controls.validation_rows: all coarse cells in every validation cube

plus_local_context: 3x3x3 neighborhood mean/std of count, velocity, and backbone

fixed_linear_controls.metrics: per-domain residual RMSE, Pearson correlation, and RMSE ratio to base at each block factor

predeclared_interpretation.sig_v_supported: plus_sig_v/base validation RMSE <=0.99 in all three domains at either common block factor
predeclared_interpretation.local_patch_supported: plus_local_context/base validation RMSE <=0.98 in all three domains at either common block factor
predeclared_interpretation.native_sig_v_channel_required: native multiplicity materiality threshold is reached
predeclared_interpretation.next_if_local_supported: freeze a multiscale locally conditioned physical residual likelihood; inject condition features at every U-Net resolution
predeclared_interpretation.next_if_only_sig_v_supported: rebuild development inputs with explicit velocity second moments before generative training
predeclared_interpretation.next_if_neither_supported: do not expand channels blindly; audit nonlinear conditional sufficiency and residual spatial copula

uncertainty_channel_boundary.simulation_catalog_velocity: exact mock value; no observational sigma exists in the frozen development files
CF4_required_channels: inverse-variance weighted mean radial peculiar velocity
propagated sigma of the mean velocity
uncertainty_channel_boundary.rule: a later simulation comparison must impose one predeclared CF4-like error model; observational sigma must never be fabricated from intrinsic velocity scatter

firewall.development_truth_role: diagnostic only after this committed freeze
